config.world: Periodic Burgers u_t + u u_x = nu u_xx at resolutions N on a ladder, from seeded initial conditions of three Fourier modes at unit amplitude, viscosities nu on a ladder including 0; spectral observers with budget B (modes 1..B); the observational geometry of perturbations by a fixed seeded set of r smooth perturbation directions (spectrum 1/k) carried along the trajectory by the tangent solver and read through each observer, the read fraction (the share of a perturbation's energy in modes 1..B) being the observational quantity and the Gram matrix of the read images its geometry; the classical diagnostics beside every sample; decaying two-dimensional Navier-Stokes as the negative control with the same observers and estimator.
config.bars: PREREG-D5.md Section 5; tolerances fixed from the pilot
